title: Composed visual
description: Ordered placements of shipped visual components over a host-owned eval stream or optimizer_run. Two bind dialects, not one firehose. Unknown component ids fail closed.

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Ordered placements of advertised compose components.

inputs.name: stream
inputs.description: Live SSE endpoint or fixture event list. Required when a placement consumes stream.

inputs.name: optimizer_run
inputs.description: Optimizer event cursor (GEPA, SFT, CISPO). Required when a placement consumes optimizer_run. Do not bind Harbor/Craftax eval traces here.

slots.name: spec
slots.description: Ordered placements of advertised compose components.

slots.name: stream
slots.description: Live SSE endpoint or fixture event list. Required when a placement consumes stream.

slots.name: optimizer_run
slots.description: Optimizer event cursor (GEPA, SFT, CISPO). Required when a placement consumes optimizer_run. Do not bind Harbor/Craftax eval traces here.

components.description: Live event log. Placement input selects stream or optimizer_run. Filter with includeKinds (envelope kind or type).
In-pane overlay that inspects the envelope selected by `from`.
Reduce ingested events to a strip: count and last scalar reward/metric if present.
Sequence slider. Writes cursor { placementId, eventId, sequence }.
Lists candidate identity from optimizer_event.v1 (candidate.accepted, delta.candidate_id, best_candidate_id). Empty and honest when those events are absent. Does not invent CISPO candidates.
